title: Impeachment trial: Baste Duterte, Trillanes prosecution’s next witnesses

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s brother, Davao Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, along with former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV, will be among the prosecution’s next set of witnesses for the impeachment trial. Counsel for the prosecution Benjamin Tolosa Jr. confirmed in a press briefing on Friday that after Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) Division Chief Rendell Sopeña, they will present Duterte, and a representative of the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth). After this, the prosecution will call Trillanes, a staunch critic of the Dutertes.
